profile.headline: Sub-system lead engineer at GM
profile.summary:
Diagnostic event monitoring software function engineer, responsible for implementing diagnostic monitoring protocol for chassis controls brake modules as specified by the product platform team and communicated to the vehicle diagnostic services as specified by the customer

•Implementation activities for FWs, DTCs, system degradation strategy and diagnostic configurations based on AUTOSAR, OBD, OBDonUDS and ZevonUDS.
•Testing activities in HIL and SIL environment.
•Performing software development according to V model Requirement Analysis, Design, Coding, Configuration, Unit test, component test and integration test for braking system module

positions.title: Sub-system lead engineer
positions.description:
*Lead complex sub-system analysis to define functional and non- functional requirements while applying Behavioral Driven Development (BDD) principles.
*Create and maintain Behavioral Test Specifications (BTS) documents for applicable subsystems.
*Collaborate with Functional System Architects and Senior Systems Engineers on requirement structure and intent and implement into testable specifications.
*Collaborate with System Engineers to decompose high-level requirements into lower-level requirements.
*Lead development meetings and discussions with key stakeholders to develop behavioral requirements.
*Create and maintain documentation in requirements management tools (e.g., DNG, Markdown, etc.)
*Develop detailed SysML diagrams such as use case diagrams and activity diagrams to support solution function development in Rhapsody.
*Lead the root cause analysis for all applicable sub-system related issues and translate solutions into new or revised requirements.
*Lead the sub-system level FMEAs and collaborate on System and Component FMEAs and manage FMEA processes across applicable sub-systems.
*Collaborate with V&V engineers and software engineers to review requirements and software implementation to ensure compliance.
*Create/execute features/stories in Jira to manage requirements development activities.

positions.title: Ingeniero de software en sistemas embebidos
positions.description:
•	Manejar de varias tareas y responsabilidades simultáneamente.
•	Adaptarse y ser flexible a nuevas responsabilidades, sistemas, herramientas.
•	Brindar una comunicación clara, concisa y precisa, trasmitiendo claramente ideas y pensamientos a sus similares, dirección y clientes.
•	Establecer y mantener una relación positiva de trabajo con sus similares, dirección y clientes.
•	Expresar el deseo de entender variados puntos de vista.
